sentences.text: Sea & Hillock Capital Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-14 under the industry code 64990, other financial service activities.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-14, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-19.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a sea word but the registered industry is financial services and the record shows no ocean use.
